predictions: Ok, last week's 19-6 week was a pretty strong improvement over week 1, but it could have been soooo much better. I lost an 11-9, a 13-11, a 13-10, and a pair of 14-10s, meaning five of my six wrong picks would have tied or flipped on a single dart! Plus… and this is the super hard part of this page… three of the teams showed up with their best (or two best!) players! Ack! And they were still so close. Dang. Anyway, that brings me to 34-15 for the season, which is 69.4% correct to this point.

Match of the week: (A Div.) Dart Attack @ Lunatic Fringe. I surely think Fringe will finally get their full roster together this week, which is huge news for them because the Attack is the real freakin' deal. The A race is a newly revitalized pile of awesome, and this match could be a huge factor in the season race. But as well as the Attack is playing, Fringe is very deep and experienced, and they keep the A lead, 14-10.

Match #2: (G Div.) The Dartifacts @ Dart Knights. Well, hello there, new Dartifacts. Your roster changes have served you quite well, you G leaders. Also, hello there, same Dart Knights. Nice to see your roster back to what it probably should've been right from the initial registration. Anyway, I'm taking the new over the same. 'Facts, 14-10.

Match #3: (E Div.) Rippin Darts @ Sharky's Machine. In what I quite openly already declared in the preseason picks to be the "who will be 2nd behind Dirty Darts" race, this match is just critical. Rippin sits undefeated, but the Machine only has a loss because they already faced the aforementioned Dirty ones. I'm taking the Machine, 14-10.

Match #4: (C Div.) Village Idiots @ Mulligan's Mafia. These two tangled all season in the spring in D, and now they're contenders here in C. The Mafia has been on fire (far outdoing my initial expectations), and it's just hard to pick against a roll like theirs. Sooo… Mafia, 13-11.

Match #5: (B Div.) Hump Day! @ Consistently Inconsistent. Well, Hump Day sure picked a bad time last week to leave their shiny new Jerry Oakley at home. I had thought this was going to be one of B division's showcase matches, but now I think it's just going to be Inconsistent gaining a little space on a challenger. Inconsistent, 14-10.

Match #6: (G Div.) Heart of Dartness @ We're Sexy & We Throw It. Dartness has started its RDL existence with a pretty strong pair of wins, and things are all coming up aces. But this week they get the "home" version of We Throw It, and… I'm taking Throw It, 14-10.

Match #7: (F Div.) That's What She Said @ Bottoms Up. Bottoms Up is exactly where I thought they would be at this point, but She Said is right behind them (and I had thought they might not be). I'm not flipping on my initial expectation just yet, so it's Bottoms, 13-11.

Match #8: (D Div.) Rif Raf @ Irish Ton. Rif Raf was fired out of a dang cannon this season, and they lead D. Once Irish Ton got enough of their players together, they hopped on the win path too. For some reason, I feel like Irish might be on the come up. IT, 13-11.

Match #9: (C Div.) Off Constantly-Reboot @ Nine Lives. More than 10 points per match being scored by these teams, and not a win to be found among them yet. Somebody will get over that first hump here. And let's go with OCR in what I think is an upset, 13-11.

Match #10: (F Div.) Shark Shooters @ Duck Duck Groove. The readdition of Som has produced exactly what I expected - Duck Duck Wins. The Shooters got on the board last week, but I think the duck flight plan continues onward. Let's go with Ducks, 15-9.
Match #11: (D Div.) Red-eye Rangers @ Liquor Possee. With two 2-0 teams and two 0-2 teams now, these teams in the 1-1 glut in D are facing an early tipping point. Things tip toward the Posse, 14-10.
Match #12: (A Div.) Show Me Your Tips @ Why So Serious? This isn't just a fight for 5th in A. It's a chance for Show Me to hold serve and get back in the chase for A's top 2 spots. Show Me, 15-9.
